lesson: The system consistently attempted to buy into Wyckoff distribution phases, misinterpreting local exhaustion as a pullback within a broader bullish trend. By ignoring the breakdown of lower-timeframe support structures in favor of long-term bullish bias, the strategy repeatedly caught falling knives.
adjustment: Implement a strict 'No-Long' filter when the 1h and 4h timeframes show a confirmed breakdown of market structure, regardless of the daily or weekly trend.
methodology_flag: Trust Wyckoff distribution signals more and prioritize lower-timeframe structure over higher-timeframe bullish bias.
